== English Virtual Original comparison ==
December, January and October retain explicit once per turn for Cyborg Construct. The later may deploy one lacks a printed timing restriction. July 2007 AR PDF pp. 21 and 44 preserves deploy-phase default but its One Rule requires the card to state a time frame. Cyborg Construct remains unique. State only the change in printed frequency, with no simultaneous duplicate claim.
